integrity: The universal classification is proved from two binary-form root sets and their projective inequivalence; finite SymPy computations only check small degrees and lattice arithmetic. Priority remains subject to unindexed literature.
scientific_limitations: Only lines on the branch surface are classified; the full Neron-Severi group and other curve classes are not computed. Characteristic zero is essential to the present proof.
title: The complete line scheme and rank-26 line lattice of an explicit sextic branch surface
